NSTNode.description:
Node Status Record (NST)
Description
Presence and identity of the peers a node knows about, as a node reports
them to operator dashboards: who the peer is (its identity record fields),
how it can be reached, whether it is online, where it is, which software
and standards versions it runs, and how the row reached the board. The
SOURCE field is the provenance of the row itself so an operator can always
answer "how did this peer get here?": declared in configuration, pinned by
an operator, or seen on a live connection. A set carries every row the
emitting node currently admits and the emitting node's own row.
One known peer as reported by the emitting node.

DN.description: Distinguished name from the peer's identity record.

MULTIFORMAT_ADDRESS.description: Multiformat addresses the peer is known by.

LAST_SEEN.description: Unix seconds of last observation; 0 = never.

LATENCY_MS.description: Round-trip latency to the peer, milliseconds; 0 = unknown.

VCARD.description: Full vCard 4.0 text derived from the peer's identity record.

IS_SELF.description: True on the node emitting this set.

UPTIME_S.description: Seconds since the emitting process started (self only).

SOURCE.description:
How this row reached the board: exactly one of "config" (declared in the
node's configuration), "pinned" (pinned by an operator) or "connected"
(seen right now on a live connection).

PINNED.description:
True for configuration and operator pins; a pinned peer keeps its row
while unreachable.

PIN_NOTE.description:
For SOURCE "config" the configuration key an operator can edit; for
SOURCE "pinned" the operator's own note. Never a manufactured label.

CONNECTED_PEER_IDS.description: Peers this peer is currently connected to, for the connection graph.

SIGNING_PUBLIC_KEY.description: Signing public key from the peer's identity record.

ENCRYPTION_PUBLIC_KEY.description: Encryption public key from the peer's identity record.

EPM_CID.description: Content identifier of the peer's identity record.

STORAGE_DAEMON_VERSION.description: Version of the content-addressed storage daemon the peer runs.

ONION_ADDRESS.description:
Onion-service address when the peer is reachable over an anonymity
network.

NST.description: Node Status Record - the set of peers a node reports.

GENERATED_AT.description: Unix milliseconds when this set was generated.

SOURCE_PEER_ID.description: Peer identifier of the emitting node.
